entries.title: Cinema Sunday: Home Alone
entries.description:
Enjoy watching Kevin use elaborate booby traps to defend his home from two bumbling burglars before reuniting with his family.
The film carries a PG rating. 
No Registration is required. 
This is our last Cinema Sunday!
